test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Bangladesh is located in which direction of India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**East**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bangladesh** is located to the **east** of India and shares a long international border with Indian states.
 
• It is bordered by the Indian states of **West Bengal, Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram**.
 
• Bangladesh is geographically positioned in **South Asia**, lying between India and Myanmar.
 
• The border between India and Bangladesh is approximately **4096 kilometers** long, making it one of the longest international borders India shares with any country.
 
• Historically, Bangladesh was a part of India until the country gained independence in **1947** and later became an independent nation in **1971**.
 
• Major rivers such as the **Ganges (Padma), Brahmaputra (Jamuna), and Meghna** flow through Bangladesh, creating fertile plains.
 
• The Sundarbans, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is located in the coastal region of Bangladesh and India, known for its **Bengal Tiger population.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **North**__

 __
 
• North of India is bordered by countries such as **China, Nepal, and Bhutan.**
 
• North India is dominated by the **Himalayan mountain range**, which acts as a natural border.
 
• Bangladesh is not located in the northern direction of India.
 
 
 
• **Northwest**__
 __
 
• Northwest India shares its border with **Pakistan.**
 
• The region includes Indian states like **Rajasthan, Punjab, and Jammu & Kashmir.**
 
• Bangladesh is not situated in the northwest direction of India.
 
 
 
• **West**__
 
 
• West India is bordered by the **Arabian Sea** and includes states such as **Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Goa.**
 
• Bangladesh is not located in the western direction of India.
